question:
**Direction: Select the appropriate synonym for the underlined word.**

I am parched,** __dehydrated__ **to the point of pain.
solution: The correct answer is **"Drained."** ***__Key Points__** __ • **"Dehydrated"** means not having the normal amount of water in your body so that you feel ill or weak. (शरीर में पानी की सामान्य मात्रा न होना जिससे आप बीमार या कमज़ोर महसूस करते हैं) • **Example**: My sister was **dehydrated**__.* • The synonym of **"Dehydrated"** is **"Drained."** • **"Drained" **mean that all the water has been removed. (सूखा) __ • **Example**:* The tank was completely **drained**__.* • The correct answer is Option 3. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1, "Braced"**, means to prepare oneself for something difficult or unpleasant. (स्‍वयं को अप्रिय स्थिति के लिए तैयार करना) • **Option 2, "Moistened"**, means to add moisture or dampness to something. (नम करना, भिगोना, गीला करना) • **Option 4, "Washed"**, means to clean something with water or another liquid. ((अपनी, दूसरे की या वस्‍तु की) सफ़ाई करना विशेषतः पानी और साबुन से (को) धोना) 42:Td46, The correct answer is **"late."**
